title: Supply air spare part replacement for an apartment unit
problem: A supply air component in an apartment unit failed, and residents lost airflow to one or more rooms.
fix: We diagnosed the fault, sourced a matching spare part for the equipment, and replaced it with commissioning checks on airflow before handover.
result: Airflow was restored to the affected rooms and the unit returned to normal operation.
metricLabel: Airflow returned to the affected rooms

title: Scheduled preventive maintenance for a factory office
problem: Filters, coils, and pressures in the office HVAC drift out of specification between visits, which leads to uneven cooling and unplanned breakdowns.
fix: We ran a scheduled preventive maintenance visit: cleaning, measured checks against manufacturer limits, and a logged service report.
result: The office HVAC was returned to specification with a documented service history for the site.
metricLabel: Service report recorded for every visit

title: Preventive maintenance for Holiday Inn Hotel
problem: Guest rooms and public areas depend on steady cooling. Drift in filters, coils, and pressures reduces comfort and raises the risk of a fault during peak occupancy.
fix: We carried out scheduled preventive maintenance across the hotel's HVAC system, with cleaning, measured checks against manufacturer limits, and a logged report for each visit.
result: The system was kept within specification through the service period, with a documented history for hotel management.
metricLabel: Service report recorded for every visit

title: Phased retrofit of a resort and hotel property
problem: Aging HVAC equipment no longer matched how the property is used, and running costs were higher than they should be.
fix: We planned a phased retrofit around the property's operating schedule, so guest areas stayed in service while the upgrade was completed.
result: The property runs on upgraded equipment with the work completed in stages, without closing the building.
metricLabel: Retrofit completed without closing the property
